draft.change: Add the Hebrew gentilic עַרְקִי with its collective sense and correct the occurrence gloss from “Naphtali” to “the Arkites.”
draft.definition: An Arkite, a member of one of the Canaanite clans. The definite singular designates the clan collectively.
draft.evidence: Genesis 10:17 names the Arkites between the Hivites and Sinites. The parallel genealogy in 1 Chronicles 1:15 preserves the same sequence.

analysis.evidence: In Genesis 10:17, וְאֶת marks the Arkites as an object alongside the Hivites and Sinites in the genealogy of Canaan. Genesis 10:18 calls the groups in this list Canaanite clans.
analysis.morphology: The definite article הַ precedes a masculine singular gentilic noun in the absolute state. The ending ־ִי marks affiliation. The singular denotes the people collectively.
